lines.text: During the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra, a descendant of Aaron the chief priest, came up from Babylon.
Ezra left Babylon on the first day of the first month and reached Jerusalem on the first day of the ninth month.
Ezra set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, to practice it, and to teach it in Israel.
The king's letter let only priests and Levites go with Ezra and told him to buy bulls, rams, and lambs.

wrong_details.wrong: only priests and Levites could go with Ezra
wrong_details.true: any volunteers among the Israelites, including priests and Levites, could go

lines.text: Ezra was to appoint magistrates and judges and teach the laws, and he blessed the LORD and gathered Israel's leaders.
